span.term: a generative probabilistic model: each document is a finite mixture over latent topics, and each topic a distribution over words
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The bag-of-words (exchangeability) assumption can split words that belong to a single phrase across different topics.
span.note: what this limits: every topic assignment over multi-word names and phrases: THE BAG-OF-WORDS ASSUMPTION ALLOWS WORDS THAT SHOULD BE GENERATED BY THE SAME TOPIC (E.G., 'WILLIAM RANDOLPH HEARST FOUNDATION') TO BE ALLOCATED TO SEVERAL DIFFERENT TOPICS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The text-classification results are presented as preliminary and needing further support.
span.note: what this limits: the text-classification result: ALTHOUGH THESE RESULTS NEED FURTHER SUBSTANTIATION, THEY SUGGEST THAT THE TOPIC-BASED REPRESENTATION ... MAY BE USEFUL AS A FAST FILTERING ALGORITHM
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Exact posterior inference in LDA cannot be done; only approximate inference is available.
span.note: what this limits: any topic solution treated as the posterior: EXACT INFERENCE IS INTRACTABLE FOR LDA, and only approximate inference algorithms are available
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The authors disclaim any epistemological claim about the variables they call topics.
span.note: what this limits: any interpretation of a fitted topic as a theme or subject: the authors state they use the word topics to exploit text-oriented intuitions and make no epistemological claims about these latent variables beyond their utility in representing probability distributions on sets of words
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The text vocabulary is stated to be an aid to intuition, and the model is not tied to text.
span.note: what this limits: any humanities reading of this model's output: the authors state the language of text collections is used to guide intuition and that the LDA model is not necessarily tied to text
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Documents as well as words are assumed exchangeable, which the authors note is less often stated.
span.note: what this limits: any use of a topic model over a corpus with an order that matters, such as a diachronic study: the methods assume documents are exchangeable, so the specific ordering of documents in a corpus can be neglected, which the authors note is less often stated formally
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: exchangeability - TWO ASSUMPTIONS, ONE OF THEM USUALLY LEFT UNSAID: words within a document are exchangeable, which is the bag-of-words assumption everyone states, and DOCUMENTS are exchangeable too, which the authors say is less often stated formally - the second is what removes time from a corpus
